title: Brothers' mining careers and boyhood trips west
summary: His brothers were geologists and mining men; as a boy he visited Oklahoma's Osage oil country and a New Mexico coal mine.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I was interested in mining, because I -- and when I was 10 or so, my brother's job was for Texas Company down in Oklahoma and I used to go out and he was there when they opened the Osage Territory there. Indian Territory when they first came in --
So I used to travel all over in the daytime I'd go out with him. And it was interesting, all -- all the geologists, they'd meet in one of these farmhouses where they have the homecooking --
and it'd be out -- oh my goodness in the wilderness someplace, you see. It was a fascinating life.
And they'd have the table loaded and all
these geologists come in and they'd eat, my goodness, it was great. So I had a taste of it.
Then my other brother at that time was down in a coalmine out in a little town in New Mexico. So I'd go out there some summer, maybe split it.
Your family was nice and close. You -- everybody was close with each other, I mean -- it was nice to go to your brother's wasn't it --
I mean there was close affection, bonds?
I think so, yeah. Oh, apparently except that --
Cause they had the kid brother come?
